info.title: SYNTHORA Agent Card Validator (A2A)
info.description: Agent Card Validator (A2A): given an Agent Card URL or JSON, deterministically validates it against the A2A spec — required fields, skill schemas, endpoint reachability, security schemes, provider transparency — returning a compatibility_score, schema_errors and warnings. The trust layer for the agent economy. Deterministic, Ed25519-signed. $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. SYNTHORA.
x-use-cases: validate an A2A Agent Card before publishing it
check an agent for A2A compatibility
score an agent registry entry for trust
verify an Agent Card's schema + endpoint
audit an agent's card before another agent uses it
